p2g3.instruction: Complete the flow chart below. Choose NO MORE THAN THREE WORDS from the passage for each answer. Write your answers in boxes 23-26.
p2g3.body: The flow chart runs down the left; each step has a linked note on the right. Step 1: Tropical warm water (note: Less [[23]]). Step 2: Water becomes [[24]] and sinks (note: Thermohaline circulation). Step 3: Deep ocean current called [[25]] (note: Increase in [[26]]). Step 4: Less dense, hard to sink (note: Stays on top). Step 5: Gulf Stream slows or shuts down.
